verdicts.spec_says: Education level shall be stored as zero.
verdicts.code_does: Education level (EDLEVEL) is hard-coded to 12, not zero (line 98).

verdicts.spec_says: The message text shall be 'Unable to automatically generate a new ID', and the user may not successfully submit a new employee until a valid identifier can be presented.
verdicts.code_does: The message text contains a typo: 'Unable to automatically generate an new ID.' (line 48). Additionally, when no valid ID was generated, the code sets no guard to block submission — GetError() never checks whether XID is blank/valid, so the user can press Enter and attempt an insert with an empty EMPNO, which fails only because of a SQL primary-key constraint (producing 'Unable to create employee' instead of the ID-error message).

undocumented.title: BIRTHDATE populated with current system date on insert
undocumented.code_does: When a new employee is inserted, the BIRTHDATE field is set to %Date (the current system date), not a value entered by the user.
undocumented.why_it_matters: No specification rule describes how BIRTHDATE is populated; storing today's date as a birth date is almost certainly incorrect and cannot be audited against any rule.

undocumented.title: EDLEVEL hard-coded to 12 instead of zero
undocumented.code_does: The education level field is always written as 12, despite a developer comment stating 'We don't actually care about these fields.'
undocumented.why_it_matters: The spec requires EDLEVEL to be zero; the non-zero default will silently corrupt the education-level data for every employee created through this screen.

undocumented.title: Salary minimum-band validation enforces HR policy not in spec
undocumented.code_does: GetError() rejects salaries below 30000, returning 'Salary below minimum band', citing a 2015-03 HR policy.
undocumented.why_it_matters: This business rule is implemented in code but has no corresponding specification rule; its correctness and continued applicability cannot be audited.

undocumented.title: GetError job-blank check emits misleading 'Phone number cannot be blank' message
undocumented.code_does: When XJOB (the Job field) is blank, the error message returned is 'Phone number cannot be blank' rather than a job-related message.
undocumented.why_it_matters: This is a copy-paste bug that presents a misleading error to the user; no spec rule describes the expected validation message for a blank Job field.
